nodes.text: You arrive in a rocky, wooded valley under soft daylight, where pale stone buildings form a stylized elven courtyard. An ornamental arch frames the entrance to a broad stone stair, which leads up to the front of a circular stone plaza. Railings run beside the stair and along the outer edges of the plaza, while the approach remains open. At the center of the plaza stands a stone altar with a cluster of blue crystals on top. The route from the stair to the altar stays clear. Two round elven homes stand on opposite sides of the plaza, each with a domed roof, ornamental roof details, and an arched entrance. Benches sit around the plaza, and lanterns stand beside the approach. Behind the homes, large trees and irregular rocks form enclosing groups. Smaller rocks, grass, flowers, and mushrooms gather around the bases of the trees. Ivy climbs selected building walls, and lush green vegetation surrounds the pale stone architecture.
